title: mini cookie cutters and metal holder
text: mini cookie cutters and metal holder. This are just what I needed (a tiny heart cutter)- and it has one) and lots of other geometric shapes.  Comes is a round metal container, however, once you open it, you will never get the lid back on - so whip out the rubber bands.  The cutters are thin metal, sharp on end, rounded metal on the other.  I'm sure they'll last a long time as I rarely use cutters, but would be fun for charcuterie or other things you might need small cutters of --- each shape comes with 3 sizes.  Am a little disappointed the metal holder is sort of junk - but you get what you pay for.  If I can find another container that will hold them all neatly, I will move them and toss the container.
